topic.title: Delete Against Delete
topic.shortdesc: Both users remove exactly the same content. This must merge cleanly, not conflict.

section.title: Overview
section.p: The Authentication Service validates user credentials and issues signed access tokens.
Tokens are signed with the key configured in auth.signing.key.
section.note: The configuration file is not reloaded automatically.

section.title: Configuring the service
section.p: The configuration file is read once, at startup.

ul.li: A JDK 21 runtime is installed on the host.
The database schema is migrated to revision 42.
Port 8443 is open for inbound TLS traffic.
A signing key of at least 256 bits is available.

section.title: Legacy session manager
section.p: The legacy SessionManager component is still shipped for backward compatibility.
It will be removed in the next major release.
